pruinose.m: Having a very fine whitish powder (bloom) on a surface.

prunellos.m: More than one prunello. prunello: a species of dried plum.

prunt.m: A small piece of glass fused to the main body of a piece of glasswork and then shaped or pressed, for decoration.

pruriginous.m: Related to, affected by, or resembling, prurigo.
